micro.purpose: Row status and time, copy chips, subheads. CSS token --text-micro (0.65625rem).

label.purpose: Buttons, pills, nav, uppercase chrome labels, mono chrome. CSS token --text-label (0.75rem).

data.purpose: Status line and tabular data. CSS token --text-data (0.78125rem).

display.purpose: Page-level heading on Settings. CSS token --text-display (1.25rem). Not a display face — the system has none.

input.purpose: Form controls and paste fallbacks. Deliberate literal 16px, outside the rem ramp, to stop iOS Safari auto-zoom.

narrow-body.purpose: Body copy under the 380px narrow-phone step. Literal 14px, outside the rem ramp.

icon-glyph.purpose: Literal glyph sizes for the chevron, expand, add and refresh marks. Drawings, not type.

mono.purpose: Terminal-adjacent output and anything the CLI would speak: code, commands, paths. The xterm pane's own size is pinch-controlled and outside this ramp.

shadows.name: chrome-lift
shadows.purpose: Bottom nav and result panel — the only surfaces that sit above the scroll canvas.

shadows.name: elev-1
shadows.purpose: Rare raised moments. Tuned for the dark charcoal surface, not flat black. Do not stack under every card.

shadows.name: elev-2
shadows.purpose: Floating chrome above content. Same restraint as elev-1.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for state feedback: background, border-color and color changes.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Settle easing for transform moves — sheet drag release and page swipe commit.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus and tone changes on actions, pills and nav. The system's default beat.

motion.name: duration-settle
motion.purpose: Transform settles, including the swipe page commit. The ceiling — motion is state feedback, never page choreography.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Narrow-phone step: body drops to 14px and the header title to 16px.

breakpoints.name: shell
breakpoints.purpose: CSS token --shell. Caps shell and bottom-nav width; content centres beyond it.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Phone chrome upper bound, paired with a coarse-pointer short-landscape clause so a landscape phone keeps phone treatment.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The one decisive action on a screen: Soft Steel Blue fill, full pill, 44px touch floor.
components.css: .ds-action { flex: 0 0 auto; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #454545); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink, #e6e6e6); font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 10px 16px; min-height: 44px; transition: border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-action-primary { background: var(--accent, #87afd7); border-color: var(--accent, #87afd7); color: var(--paper, #161616); } .ds-action-primary:hover, .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { background: var(--accent-bright, #a3c6e8); border-color: var(--accent-bright, #a3c6e8); outline: none; } .ds-action-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Every non-primary operator action. Transparent with a Rule Strong hairline; hover strengthens the border rather than filling.
components.css: .ds-action-secondary { flex: 0 0 auto; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #454545); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink, #e6e6e6); font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 10px 16px; min-height: 44px; transition: border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-action-secondary:hover, .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ink-soft, #c6c6c6); outline: none; }

components.name: Destructive Action
components.description: Fault Rose text on a deep rose hairline at rest; fills only on hover or the confirm step, which nudges once.
components.css: .ds-action-destructive { flex: 0 0 auto; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--danger-deep, #5f3535); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--danger, #d78787); font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 10px 16px; min-height: 44px; transition: border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease, background 140ms ease; } .ds-action-destructive:hover, .ds-action-destructive:focus-visible { background: var(--danger, #d78787); border-color: var(--danger-bright, #e3a5a5); color: var(--paper, #161616); outline: none; }

components.name: Primary Pill
components.description: The compact sibling of the action button — connection, result, sheet and pane chrome. Same pill language at a 34px height.
components.css: .ds-pill { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #454545); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink, #e6e6e6); font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 8px 16px; min-height: 34px; transition: background 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-pill-primary { background: var(--accent, #87afd7); border-color: var(--accent, #87afd7); color: var(--paper, #161616); } .ds-pill-primary:hover, .ds-pill-primary:focus-visible { background: var(--accent-bright, #a3c6e8); border-color: var(--accent-bright, #a3c6e8); outline: none; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Soft Charcoal fill on a Rule Strong hairline. The 16px type is deliberate: anything smaller makes iOS Safari zoom the viewport on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; background: var(--paper, #161616); color: var(--ink, #e6e6e6); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #454545); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); transition: border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-bright, #a3c6e8); }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Two-column fixed bar capped at the shell width. New is the sole new-task CTA and the only filled cell; the current page takes an accent wash and border. Opaque paper, not blur: iOS restores backdrop-filter layers as a black tile after backgrounding.
components.css: .ds-bottom-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 8px; width: min(560px, 100%); margin: 0 auto; padding: 8px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #2a2a2a); background: var(--paper, #161616); box-shadow: 0 -6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); } .ds-bottom-nav button { min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-muted, #a8a8a8); font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: background 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-bottom-nav button:hover, .ds-bottom-nav button:focus-visible { background: var(--paper-raised, #242424); color: var(--ink, #e6e6e6); outline: none; } .ds-bottom-nav button[aria-current="page"] { border-color: var(--accent, #87afd7); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-deep, #24384c) 55%, var(--paper-tint, #1d1d1d)); color: var(--ink, #e6e6e6); } .ds-bottom-nav button[data-bottom-action="new-task"] { background: var(--accent, #87afd7); color: var(--paper, #161616); } .ds-bottom-nav button[data-bottom-action="new-task"]:hover, .ds-bottom-nav button[data-bottom-action="new-task"]:focus-visible { background: var(--accent-bright, #a3c6e8); color: var(--paper, #161616); }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: The whole status vocabulary in 9px. Fills from --tone, which a tone-* class sets; running pulses and collapses under reduced motion. Never paired with a side stripe on the row.
components.css: .ds-status-row { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-muted, #a8a8a8); } .ds-tone-running { --tone: var(--accent, #87afd7); --tone-bg: rgba(135, 175, 215, 0.14); } .ds-status-dot { flex: none; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--tone, var(--rule-strong, #454545)); animation: ds-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.45; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Interact Strip
components.description: Signature surface. Structured Approve/Deny for the agent, as a flat hairline band above the xterm pane — deliberately not a composer, because the raw terminal owns the work.
components.html: Apply patch to routes.ts?
components.css: .ds-interact { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--paper-tint, #1d1d1d); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #2a2a2a); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #2a2a2a); } .ds-interact-prompt { font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink, #e6e6e6); } .ds-interact-prompt code { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft, #c6c6c6); } .ds-interact-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex: none; }

narrative.overview:
Ajax is the product and the visual brief: a pocket operator console for a local agent fleet. Soft Charcoal surfaces, Soft Steel Blue as the running signal, and a terminal pane that owns the work. Chrome is sparse, pill-decisive, and mobile-first for Safari on iPhone — status, required decision, then the raw tmux/xterm bridge.

Density stays operational, not decorative. Tone carries meaning (`running` / `waiting` / `error` / `done`); accents are CLI-locked to match Native Cockpit. Motion is short state feedback (≈140–220ms), never page choreography. The system rejects generic SaaS dashboards (card grids, metric strips, soft purple/indigo chrome) and overbuilt IDE shells that fight the terminal.
keyCharacteristics: Soft Charcoal stack with hairline rules; depth mostly from paper steps
Soft Steel Blue as primary action and running tone; semantic amber / rose / sage for wait / fault / done
Pill actions (44px min) and uppercase tracked chrome labels
Shell width capped at 560px; iOS safe-area and keyboard geometry are first-class
Terminal is the signature surface; UI never competes with the pane
Fixed rem type ramp in CSS (`--text-micro` … `--text-display`); no Inter in the stack

rules.name: The One Tone Rule
rules.body: Status is a single `--tone` / `--tone-bg` pair consumed by dots, badges, rows, and interact pills. Never invent a parallel status color path.

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Soft Steel Blue and semantic accents appear for running state, primary CTA, or attention — not as decorative fill across idle chrome.

rules.name: The No-Display Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a display or serif face into Cockpit chrome.

rules.name: The Label Cadence Rule
rules.body: Uppercase + tracked labels are reserved for chrome (header, empty, settings), not for every section heading on a page.

rules.name: The No Side-Stripe Rule
rules.body: Never use `border-left` / `border-right` > 1px as a status accent — use `--tone` / section grouping.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Task rows and content panels stay tonal. If a shadow appears on a list card, remove it.

dos: Do lead every task screen with status + next safe action, then the terminal.
Do use Soft Steel Blue only for primary CTA and running/selection state.
Do keep actions pill-shaped with ≥44px height on touch.
Do convey depth with Soft Charcoal paper steps before reaching for shadow.
Do keep accents locked to CLI cockpit values (xterm 110 / 179 / 174 / 108).
Do use the rem type ramp tokens for UI type; keep listed literal exceptions only.
donts: Don't ship generic SaaS dashboards: card grids, metric strips, soft purple/indigo chrome.
Don't build overbuilt IDE shells: too many panels and tabs fighting the terminal.
Don't use side-stripe borders (`border-left` / `border-right` > 1px) as status accents — use the tone system.
Don't use gradient text, glass cards as decoration, or hero-metric templates.
Don't put a browser composer or snapshot viewer where the raw terminal belongs — except on the flag-gated orchestration session route.
Don't invent a second status color vocabulary outside `--tone`.
Don't duplicate the New-task CTA (bottom-nav New only).
